activity.notes: Garvey founded the Universal Negro Improvement Association (UNIA) in Jamaica in 1914 and left for the United States in 1916. ATLAS treats Jamaica here as Garvey's own political-community context, not as the British colonial administration he opposed. Because he then spent more than a decade abroad, his Jamaican activity is split rather than drawn as one continuous 1914–1935 rail.
